propositions: Provider-qualified model references (e.g. 'anthropic:claude-opus-4-8') passed to genai-prices.calc_price trigger LookupError for Anthropic and OpenAI but not Bedrock, causing silent drops to 'unpriced' status without warning.

The asymmetric failure creates a measurement bias in provider cost comparisons, where only Bedrock shows pricing figures while Anthropic and OpenAI appear blank despite all models being known to genai-prices.

Model id translation must be decided by registry membership (KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES) rather than prefix splitting or string parsing, because some provider-qualified ids contain colons that would be incorrectly split (e.g. versioned AWS ids).

Unpriced rows must remain tolerated (pricing is best-effort and never breaks summarize) but must be visibly distinguishable—genuinely unknown models should render bare while malformed ids should preserve their malformation in output.
